text:
maya: Quick heads-up — we want to introduce a new header and SDK convenience for batch affinity: `x-rw-batch-affinity`. Goal: let clients pin related requests (user/session) into the same batching window/worker so latency and KV-cache hits improve. Thoughts on telemetry + console impact?

taylor: Love the idea. Two quick questions: 1) Is this additive (opt-in) or will it replace the current `route-tag` behavior? 2) How does it interact with existing quota attribution?

maya: Good q. Plan is opt-in first. We'll add support to Python + TS + Go SDKs, docs show migration. Quota attribution should remain by default using cost center headers; batch-affinity only influences routing/batching, not billing.

raj: Important: console needs a way to surface affinity-heavy traffic so customers can see when affinity increases token throughput. Otherwise they'll think it's a bug. Also need to show affinity hit-rate metric (cache hits from affinity).

luke: Agreed. For telemetry we should emit a new tag `affinity_hint` in request traces and a rate metric `batch_affinity_applied` boolean per request. Both should be sampled at 100% for Dedicated customers, and 10% for hosted by default.

amelia: UX note — if we add a per-route toggle in Console (Enable batch affinity), we should show an explainer: "Affinity groups related requests to improve cache/KV hits; may increase tail latency for mismatched sessions." Short and non-technical.

eric: Implementation gotcha: streaming/generative endpoints currently rely on continuous token streaming websocket paths. We must ensure adding header doesn't break streaming fallback or chunking. Could be a subtle proxy routing mismatch if header is stripped at edge.

ci-bot: build 2026.03.12.412 passed: added basic header parsing in routing proxy. Please run integration tests for streaming.

maya: Good call, eric. We'll add an integration matrix: batch-affinity=on/off x streaming=on/off x region. Also add unit tests for header passthrough.

raj: About dashboards — we should add a small panel to per-model view: "Affinity effect" showing latency p50/p95 with and without affinity (can be derived from `affinity_hint`). Prefer a rollout where we capture baseline for 48h then surface suggested routes.

taylor: For SDKs — propose API: Python: `client.generate(..., batch_affinity="user-123")` which sets header under the hood. TS/Go mirror. Also expose `None` to clear. Breaking change risk: don't change default behavior.

luke: Telemetry schema change: add `affinity_id` field to span attributes (string, optional), add `affinity_applied` boolean. Add to console log search indexing. Need schema bump note.

amelia: Are we planning to deprecate `route-tag`? Some customers use it for cost routing, conflating semantics could be dangerous.

maya: No deprecation in plan. We'll keep `route-tag` for policy-level routing/quota. Batch-affinity is narrower: it's a hint to the serving runtime for batching/kv affinity. We'll document distinctions clearly.

eric: For rollout strategy: start with internal + Dedicated customers as opt-in flag. Once we verify affinity hit-rate and no adverse tail-latency, open to hosted beta. Also add automatic fallback in router if affinity causes too-high latency — revert to default routing after N failures.

raj: Console UX for rollouts: have a small modal when users enable affinity explaining sample rate + expected effects, with link to "affinity runbook". Also add telemetry alert: if p95 increases by >25% after enabling, auto-disable and annotate.

maya: I'll draft the SDK PRs. Proposed timeline: 2 weeks for Python + tests, 1 week for TS/Go followups, then internal canary, then Dedicated opt-in. Anyone want to pair on the Python client ergonomics?

taylor: I can pair tomorrow AM (US-PST).

luke: I'll own the telemetry side (schema + dashboard tile).

amelia: I'll write the console copy and modal content.

eric: I'll add streaming integration tests and the router fallback logic.

ci-bot: NOTE: remember to add `x-rw-batch-affinity` to allowed headers list in edge config.

deploy-bot: Rollout checklist created: https://redwood.internal/affinity-rollout-checklist (private link) :white_check_mark:

maya: Thanks all. Action items: Maya (SDK PR + doc draft), Taylor (pairing), Luke (telemetry), Amelia (console content), Eric (integration + fallback), Raj (dashboard panels). We'll sync next Tue 10:30. :calendar:
